title: Understanding the Parameter Vector
text: The parameter vector \( $$\theta$$ \) in a linear regression model represents the coefficients for each feature in the dataset, including the intercept.

title: Dimensions of the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix \( X \) includes all the features and the intercept. If there are $$400$$ flight records and $$9$$ features, what would be the dimensions of \( X \)?

title: Including the Intercept
text: Remember that the design matrix \( X \) includes an intercept term, which adds an additional column to the matrix.
